title: Eddoboozi Eryagaana Okuggwaamu essuubi
intro: Yingira mu maka ng’okufiirwa kugoberera okufiirwa, naye ate eddoboozi erimu erikkakkamu ligaana okuggwaamu essuubi. Omulanga gumu mu Qur’an gufuula obugumiikiriza okuba enkyukakyuka; osobola okulondoola obukodyo okutuuka ku muntu ali emabega w’eddoboozi eryo?
clues: Nnali ddoboozi ly’obugumiikiriza munda mu maka ng’emikisa gigezesebwa akabi.
Nasigala mu maka agataliimu bantu olw’okufiirwa obugagga n’abaana.
Namanya nti n’obulwadde bwali bugudde munne oyo, omubiri gwe ogwali gubonaabona.
Obunkenke bwe bwakaluba, nakoowoola nga nzijukiza Allah.
Nawaayo okulangirira kumu: Allah ye Mazima, kale sigala mugumiikiriza.
Nayita Ayub amannya ge; oluvannyuma, Allah yaggyawo okubonaabona n’azzaawo amaka.
